input.query: WITH d AS (SELECT decision_date, SUM(n_approved) AS approved, SUM(n_decisions) AS decisions, SUM(n_approved)::DOUBLE/NULLIF(SUM(n_decisions),0) AS approval_rate FROM agg_kyc_daily WHERE decision_date >= DATE '2025-10-01' AND decision_date <= DATE '2025-12-15' GROUP BY 1) SELECT * FROM d ORDER BY decision_date

SELECT month, platform, doc_type, reject_reason, SUM(n_rejections) AS n_rejections FROM agg_kyc_reject_reasons_monthly WHERE month >= DATE '2025-08-01' AND month <= DATE '2025-12-01' GROUP BY 1,2,3,4 ORDER BY month, platform, doc_type, n_rejections DESC
